hook: 2 or More? You're Blocking Your Own Luck

voices.name: l00
voices.text: If two or more of these fit you, <#0.2#> you're blocking your own luck.
voices.caption: If 2 or more of these fit you, you're blocking your own luck.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: One. <#0.2#> When someone compliments you, you wave it away.
voices.caption: 1. When someone compliments you, you wave it away.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Two. <#0.2#> You say sorry out of habit, even when you did nothing wrong.
voices.caption: 2. You say sorry out of habit, even when you did nothing wrong.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Three. <#0.2#> When you rest, you feel guilty for no reason.
voices.caption: 3. When you rest, you feel guilty for no reason.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Four. <#0.2#> You can't leave a relationship that hurts you.
voices.caption: 4. You can't leave a relationship that hurts you.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: How many? <#0.2#> Drop the number in the comments. <#0.2#> And starting today, love yourself first.
voices.caption: How many? Drop the number in the comments. And starting today, love yourself first.
